test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) in the following series to continue the pattern?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8e141122f732cd974e171364d10ad1bdfc19eb484bbe35d137406520b1a384e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The first and second column elements shift clockwise subsequently.

No change in the rest of the elements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a4a2a80c9723d5468e5285c2b6bd20ceb9e6c1f42f48174b72a9623c64e1034.png] 

2) Second box series →

The first row elements shift clockwise subsequently.

No change in the rest of the elements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca304b307216a037c3c1a6a01d1cc5fcf4d35b4507afc3e40d1d701bb7c68979.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37bd90a3e631ac50347493d10d6683f69759285dd87dfd1ffa16079dbef04ec3.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
